messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "reserve_courtesy_car is not in the complete tool list; courtesy cars cannot be reserved by the agent.", "verifier": {"reason": "The assistant attempted to call a non-existent tool (`reserve_courtesy_car`) to reserve a courtesy car, which is explicitly forbidden by the policy (q11). The policy mandates that courtesy cars can only be reserved by the workshop on the day of the visit, and the assistant must instruct the customer to ask at reception. Additionally, the assistant is restricted to using only the tools listed in the [AVAILABLE TOOLS] section (q12)."}}
